_about: Every element the eBay module uses. Scripts reference them as @@key@@ (css) or @@key.text@@. eBay ships stable data-testid hooks on item pages and data-listingid on result cards - prefer them over generated class names. Fix a broken selector here, then: python @modules/module_kit.py verify ebay --write

search_box.name: Search for anything
search_box.description: Global search input (id gh-ac, form field name _nkw, in form#gh-f -> /sch/i.html); present on every eBay page. type_cdp finds it by the xpath (clicks it, clears, types).

search_submit.name: Search
search_submit.description: The header Search button (button type=submit; the point under its centre is its label span gh-search-button__label). The same form has 'Clear search' and 'Camera icon' buttons - never take the first button in the form.

result_card.description: One search result. data-listingid is eBay's own attribute; the item id comes from the /itm/ link inside.

card_item_link.description: Link to the listing; /itm/<id>. A placeholder card links /itm/123456 and is skipped.

results_count.description: 'N results for <query>' - N counts exact matches only.

fewer_words_divider.description: Divider after the exact matches; everything after it is filler.

next_page.description: Next results page; absent or aria-disabled on the last page.

bin_price.description: Buy It Now price; absent on auction-only listings.

bid_price.description: Current bid on auctions ('US $1,375.00' + bids + time) - never treated as a purchase price.

watchers_signal.description: Demand signal: 'People want this. 108 people are watching this.' Absent when few watch - then the count is unknown, not 0.

buy_it_now_button.description: Read for presence only. NEVER clicked by this module.

place_bid_button.description: Read for presence only (auction). NEVER clicked.
place_bid_button.notes: confirmed on a live auction; read for presence only, NEVER clicked

shipping_section.description: Shipping cost and method, 'Located in:', delivery estimate 'to <ZIP>'.

returns_section.description: Return policy ('30 days returns. Seller pays for return shipping').

shop_confidence.description: Top Rated Plus / Money Back Guarantee badges.

item_specifics.description: Item specifics section (Brand, Model, MPN, memory size ...).

spec_pair.description: Item-specifics label (<dt>); its value is the next <dd>. Semantic dl/dt/dd, verified 2026-10-28 (the ux-labels-values testid is only used in the shipping section).

photos.description: Photo gallery; image URLs rewritten to s-l1600 for full size.

description_frame.description: Seller's description iframe (itm.ebaydesc.com) - the extension reads only the main frame, so its src is opened.

store_info.description: About this seller: % positive, items sold, joined, response time.

buy_box.description: Right-hand buy box (title, price, options, buttons). Variation pickers inside it are listbox buttons/selects.

msku_panel.description: Option panel of a multi-option listing (CPU / RAM / GPU / Storage menus). Seen 2026-10-28 (user-supplied HTML).
msku_panel.notes: user-supplied absolute XPath of the panel, kept only as a reference: /html/body/div[2]/main/div[1]/div[1]/div[4]/div[2]/div

msku_menu_button.description: One option menu; its label (span.btn__label) is 'CPU:', 'RAM:' ...; aria-controls points at its listbox.

msku_option.description: One choice; data-sku-value-name equals the option name in the page's embedded MSKU data.
